name: map()
desc: Re-maps a number from one range to another.
syntax: float map(float value, float start1, float stop1, float start2, float stop2)

params.name: value
params.desc: the incoming value to be converted

params.name: start1
params.desc: lower bound of the input range

params.name: stop1
params.desc: upper bound of the input range

params.name: start2
params.desc: lower bound of the output range

params.name: stop2
params.desc: upper bound of the output range
